card.name: The word detect before abuse or diversion
card.fires_on: The word "detect" in the standard opioid-label sentence about how to prevent and detect abuse or diversion of this product, after "prevent and".

modes.label: Detect abuse or diversion
modes.description: "detect" after "prevent and" in the line telling readers to contact the state licensing or controlled-substances authority.
modes.example: Contact local state professional licensing board or state-controlled substances authority for information on how to prevent and<< detect>> abuse or diversion of this product.

card.writes: It suppresses crime words such as laundering, mafia and smuggling, which fits a word about abuse and diversion coming next.
card.plain: It marks the word "detect" in the stock sentence about preventing and detecting drug abuse or diversion.
